title: Discover, city pages and the feed time out reading public_events: 576 failures for 387 people since September, latest November 15

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: Vercel runtime errors, 7-day window: "[discover] public_events failed" code 57014 statement timeout, count 576, 387 users, routes /discover, /discover/events, /discover/circles, /discover/cities/*, /feed; first 2026-09-14, last 2026-11-15 10:47Z. EXPLAIN ANALYZE of public.public_events(_limit=>60) on Frequency Community just now: 289 ms, 5,212 buffer hits, warm. lib/discover.ts listRead fails soft to [] and ISR (revalidate 3600) can then serve an empty list for an hour.

WHY IT MATTERS: The launch-week front door (Discover, towns, feed) shows empty lists or errors under load, and a soft-failed render can be cached empty for an hour. The 11-03 note said these had stopped; they have not.

FIX DIRECTION: Make the read cheap and cacheable: a narrow snapshot or materialized read for the public list (index-backed), keep listRead from caching an empty failure into ISR, and report soft failures into a gate that notices.

Narrow partial index events_public_events_snapshot_idx (migration 20270346061000, not yet applied) plus lib/public-events-snapshot.ts last-good snapshot; a failed read serves the snapshot or throws, never caches an empty list.
